interface Same[V: Equal]:
	fn same(other: V) Bool

interface Read[V]:
	fn get() V

type Box[T]:
	value: T

impl Same[T] for Box[T]:
	fn same(other: T) Bool:
		return self.value == other

impl Read[T] for Box[T]:
	fn get() T:
		return self.value

fn read[T](value: Box[T]) T:
	return value.get()
